thread:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P0 - Elevated errors for Redwood API (eu-west-1). Error threshold tripped: 502/504 rate > 10% over 5m. Pager: @tzeng-oncall. Runbook: /runbooks/api-errors.md. Please acknowledge and post initial impact summary.

 tzeng-oncall: ack. I'm pulling logs and checking worker pools now. grabbing heap profiles and recent deploys.

 alice.sre: seeing spike starting ~2025-06-03T10:50Z. 502 + 504s across gen-eu-2 worker pool. No deploys in last hour on that pool. Reproducing locally with a small replay.

 leo-eng: checking autoscaler metrics — queue depth + CPU on gen-eu-2 jumped. KV cache evictions spiked too. Could be a sudden request shape change.

 marta-pm: need quick customer impact: which routes/models affected? Are embeddings impacted or just generation? We'll need a statuspage draft ASAP.

 jamie-comms: I can start a short status update. Draft below — pls confirm scope/content so I can publish: 

 ```
 Service: Redwood API - Text Generation
 Impact: Customers in EU (eu-west-1) may see increased 502/504 errors and elevated latency when hitting generation endpoints. Not all requests affected; subset of model worker pool impacted.
 Status: Investigating
 Updated: 2025-06-03T10:55Z UTC
 Guidance: We are rolling out mitigations. If you see failures, retries with exponential backoff are recommended.
 ```

 tzeng-oncall: confirmed it's limited to gen-eu-2 worker pool handling medium/long sequences for.release-models. Initiating mitigation: scale gen-eu-2 by +2 nodes, enable fallback routing to gen-eu-1 for requests that exceed threshold. Applying now.

 alice.sre: scaled pool and toggled fallback routing to gen-eu-1. Running smoke tests. Error rate -> monitoring.

 jamie-comms: updated draft to include mitigation steps and explicit customer guidance: "We have enabled automatic fallback routing and scaled capacity; requests should succeed with retries. We'll post updates every 20 minutes until resolved."

 olivia-support: getting some tickets about timeouts from EU customers. I'll send a short note to affected accounts pointing to the status page once you publish.

 leo-eng: observing error rate dropping from ~28% to ~7% within 6 minutes after scale/fallback. Latency still slightly elevated for long sequences.

 tzeng-oncall: error rate now ~1.2% and trending down. I'll change status to Identified and include root-cause hypothesis.

 jamie-comms: updated statuspage to Identified. New draft copy: 

 ```
 Service: Redwood API - Text Generation
 Impact: Partial errors and higher latency for some generation requests in EU (eu-west-1).
 Scope: Affected requests routed to worker pool gen-eu-2 for certain models/sequence lengths.
 Status: Identified - mitigation in progress
 Mitigation: Scaled gen-eu-2 and enabled fallback routing to gen-eu-1. Error rates decreasing.
 Next update: 2025-06-03T11:15Z UTC
 ```

 marta-pm: approve. Jamie please publish the Identified update and ping me for customer comms cadence.

 jamie-comms: Published update to status page and internal #prod-alerts. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2156001111 (published at 2025-06-03T11:12Z)

 incident-bot: Automated note — statuspage update published by jamie-comms at 2025-06-03T11:12Z.

 tzeng-oncall: root cause identified: autoscaler policy misconfiguration combined with a traffic burst producing long-running requests which caused worker OOMs and queue backpressure in gen-eu-2. Fix: rollback bad autoscaler config, increase mem limits temporarily, restart impacted pods. Executing now.

 alice.sre: rolled autoscaler change back, bumped mem limit on gen-eu-2, restarted pods. Observability shows healthy pods and stable memory.

 leo-eng: post-fix metrics: error rate 0.35% and latency back to baseline for most sequences. No further OOMs.

 jamie-comms: drafted resolved notice. Please confirm and I will publish final update and mark incident resolved. Draft: 

 ```
 Service: Redwood API - Text Generation
 Impact: Earlier today, customers in EU experienced increased 502/504 errors and higher latency for generation requests.
 Resolution: We identified an autoscaler configuration regression that, combined with a traffic burst, caused memory pressure and OOMs on a worker pool. We reverted the config, restarted affected workers, and scaled capacity. Error rates have returned to normal.
 Status: Resolved
 Time resolved: 2025-06-03T11:25Z UTC
 Follow-up: Postmortem and action items will be shared in ~48h.
 ```

 olivia-support: publishing resolved note to affected tickets and closing duplicates. Customers emailed a summary.

 jamie-comms: Published resolved update and closed incident on status page.

 marta-pm: thanks team. Please add action items to the postmortem: 1) autoscaler validation test, 2) add better long-sequence load tests, 3) runbook update to include fallback toggle steps.

 alice.sre: creating postmortem doc and todo list, will tag owners and link in #postmortems.

 tzeng-oncall: leaving on-call notes: mitigation steps, timestamps, and pointer to logs. handing off monitoring to oncall-shift-b for 2h observation.

 jamie-comms: final note — great cross-team response. Will follow up with a short customer-facing timeline in the postmortem. :thumbsup:
